t: Declared ranking criteria — Ranked Result Delivery (Signature)
title: Declared ranking criteria — Ranked Result Delivery (Signature)
description:
Signature edition — an original Signature-authored completion, clearly labeled as Signature work and never presented as public record. Ranked result delivery turns an unordered candidate set into a defensible ordering. Every position in the ranking is produced by declared criteria — relevance, freshness, authority, diversity — combined through a transparent scoring function, and the criteria travel with the results so consumers can audit why item three beat item four. Good ranking is what separates a search engine from a grep: it models what the caller actually wants, not just what matches.
